items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: I only worked with Roy Zinnerman for a dollar and a half a night at the spotlight.

ctx.x: And, uh, which Angelo is this? The guitar player?

Angelo Pram, Pramensal. Yeah. He played guitar. And, uh, well, these, these three, three fellas teamed up together. And, uh, you talk about some wonderful harmony. Cause I know Shields was good in his harrow. And, uh, Jack Marano played, uh, tenor, double clarinet too with Shields. And, uh, uh, when the three of them played, uh, Jack was playing alto. And, uh, and, uh, and, uh, Shields and, uh, Lester Nelson was playing tenor. Man, they made a fine team up. I was a good band in them days. But, uh, all in all,…
